card.name: The word precise before a noun
card.fires_on: The adjective "precise" placed right before a noun such as role, value, delivery, time or statements, in explanatory or scientific prose.

modes.label: Precise + abstract noun
modes.description: "precise" introduces an exact role, value or prevalence that is uncertain or depends on other factors.

modes.label: Precise + descriptive noun
modes.description: "precise" modifies concrete things such as outlines, statements, word choices or delivery.
